## Hypothesis

We are analyzing the top keeper from shotgun_scalper_stage4 to determine if it represents a genuine edge on J's anchor days or overfit to non-J days. The keeper shows strong wide_pnl and Sharpe but edge_capture (506.55) falls below the OP-16 floor of 771, suggesting it may not capture the strategy's core edge.

## Mechanism

The keeper's combo parameters:
- tp_premium_pct: 0.75 (exit 2/3 position at +75% premium gain)
- stop_premium_pct: -0.35 (stop loss at -35% premium)
- time_stop_min: 12 (exit by 12 minutes after entry)
- strike_offset: 2 (likely OTM put strike)
- chandelier_arm_pct: 0.6 (profit-lock arms at +60% favor)
- vol_ratio_threshold: 1.2 (entry requires volume > 1.2x average)

This appears to be a scalper variant with quick exits, moderate profit targets, and tight stops.
